metadata.question: Did the volcanic plume from Mount Lewotobi Laki-Laki on the Indonesian island of Flores drift westward at about 2 pm local time on July 7, 2025?

data.exec_msg:
No Sentinel-2 or Landsat images found for the specified date/time.
Evidence: Geostationary data (like Himawari) would be needed for hourly tracking,
but analysis of high-resolution polar-orbiting satellites is used here for clarity.
Neither S2 nor L9 had an overpass at this exact time.
A
